description: Step text formatting up or down the way the Type keyboard commands do: font size up or down by points or by Font Size Step Up/Down, kern or track looser or tighter, Clear Tracking, Uniform Type (scales back to 100%), and Fit Headline (Type > Fit Headline, area type)

amount.description: Points for size_up/size_down (default 2); thousandths of an em for kern and track operations (default 20)

operation.description: size_up: Increase the font size by amount points (default 2); size_down: Decrease the font size by amount points (default 2); size_step_up: Font Size Step Up: the next size in the font size menu (whole frames); size_step_down: Font Size Step Down (whole frames); kern_looser: Add amount (default 20) thousandths of an em of kerning at each character; kern_tighter: Remove amount (default 20) thousandths of an em of kerning at each character; track_looser: Add amount (default 20) to the tracking; track_tighter: Remove amount (default 20) from the tracking; clear_tracking: Set tracking to 0; uniform_type: Set horizontal and vertical scale to 100%; fit_headline: Fit Headline: track the paragraph to fill the width of its area type

range.description: Characters to format in each frame (or in the selected text): start is the 0-based character offset; length defaults to the rest of the text. Default: all the text

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true. Text frames inside groups are included; with selection: true and text selected with the Type tool, the selected text is used

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: adjust_text
title: Adjust Text
